::: proof

For entry $(i,j)$, where row $i$ indexes the denominator $\vcoef$
and column $j$ indexes the numerator $\matr{A}\vecf{v}$
(see @def-vector-valued-derivative):

$$
\ba
\sb{\deriv{\vcoef} (\matr{A}\vecf{v})}_{ij}
&= \deriv{\coef{i}} (\matr{A}\vecf{v})_j \\
&= \deriv{\coef{i}} \sumto{k}{q} a_{jk} v_k \\
&= \sumto{k}{q} a_{jk} \deriv{\coef{i}} v_k \\
&= \sumto{k}{q} \sb{\deriv{\vcoef} \vecf{v}}_{ik} \sb{\tp{\matr{A}}}_{kj} \\
&= \sb{\paren{\deriv{\vcoef} \vecf{v}} \tp{\matr{A}}}_{ij}
\ea
$$

:::
